text: Looking after my nephew, he's 11 months. Runny nose and sneezing since yesterday, fine. But he's turned down every bottle and won't even take water off a spoon today, nothing at all. Also found some purplish marks on his legs, like little bruises, but he hasn't banged himself. Rolled a glass over them and could still see them clear as anything. What do I do, A&E or wait?
